name: Iznasilovannoe leto
source: Once again, Semyon arrives at the camp! Even though the number of his loops surpassed a thousand a long time ago, a very interesting plan has formed in his mind. As for what exactly that plan is, you have already figured it out from the title.
translation: 谢苗再次来到营地！尽管他的循环次数早已超过千次，但他的脑海中已经形成了一个非常有趣的计划。至于这个计划到底是什么，大家从标题就已经猜到了。
